annotations.title: Find local pros for a home job

description: Counts the local businesses near a US ZIP code that CrewButton can send a homeowner's job to, for a home-service trade such as plumbing, electrical, HVAC, cleaning or roofing, and gives a link to send the job. Local businesses reply with prices in writing. Use it when someone needs a local pro for a home repair or service. Read-only: it does not book anyone or share anyone's contact details.

trade.description: The kind of work, as one of CrewButton's trade names (for example Plumbing, Electrical, HVAC, Cleaning, Roofing). For a general repair, use Handyman.

zip.description: The 5-digit US ZIP code where the work is.
